Yes, please. One question first: my friend Paul is allergic to nuts. Does the pesto have nuts in it?
Yes, it does. Our pesto has pine nuts. For Paul, I recommend the tomato and basil pasta. It has no nuts.
Perfect. And I would like to try the risotto. Does it have dairy in it?
Yes, it has butter and cheese. But we can make it without cheese. Is that OK?
Yes, without cheese, please. And is the chicken spicy? I can't eat very spicy food.
It is a bit spicy. The chef can make it with no red pepper. Just tell me.
Great. Thank you for checking every ingredient. You are very kind.

Hi Marlene, it is Giulia from Hotel Firenze. You asked me about a good place for dinner tonight. I recommend Osteria del Ponte, near the old bridge. It is small, but the food is wonderful. You should try the pasta with tomato and basil. It has no meat, and it is not spicy. Be careful with the pesto, because it has nuts in it. I know your friend Paul is allergic to nuts. The fish soup is famous, but it has a lot of seafood, so it is not good for everybody. If you cannot eat something, just tell the waiter. They can make many dishes without cheese or without gluten. The osteria opens at seven thirty. Enjoy your dinner.

Good evening, and welcome to Osteria del Ponte. Tonight we have three specials. The first is spaghetti with clams and shrimp. It is our best seafood dish. The second is a vegetable risotto with mushrooms and parmesan cheese, so it has dairy in it. The third is roast chicken with potatoes and a little red pepper. It is a bit spicy. All our pasta has gluten, but we also have gluten-free pasta. We can make it for you in fifteen minutes. If you have an allergy, please tell me before you order, and I can check every ingredient with the chef. Enjoy your evening.
